title: Hindi H1 Sample Pack
goal: Take a zero-knowledge learner through a no-shame Hindi restart using listen-first teaching before moving to consonants.

lessons.title: Hindi Is For Me
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner feels safe restarting Hindi and hears the difference between अ and आ.
quizOutline: Which sound is short: अ or आ?
Which sound is used in आम?
Which letter should the learner trace after hearing the longer sound?
What picture anchor is used for आ?
What should happen first in this lesson: listening or testing?
lessons.heroPrompt: A warm, child-friendly Indian learning corner, large Devanagari letters अ and आ floating in bright colors, one mango image as the anchor for आ, soft classroom light, no text overlays, educational illustration style.

videoScenes.narration: Hindi is for you. We will go slowly. We will listen first.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Smiling child seated calmly at a study table, friendly Hindi teacher figure nearby, warm yellow and orange palette.

videoScenes.narration: अ... अ... अ... repeat seven times.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Full-screen large orange अ on a clean cream background with gentle motion lines.

videoScenes.narration: आ... आ... आ... repeat seven times. आ for आम.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Large red-orange आ beside a ripe mango on a simple bright background.

videoScenes.narration: Short sound: अ. Long sound: आ.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Two side-by-side sound cards showing अ and आ with short vs long wave shapes.

videoScenes.narration: Now trace one big अ and one big आ.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Worksheet-style dotted outlines for अ and आ with a child's pencil entering frame.

lessons.title: Swar Set 1
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner recognizes and repeats अ, आ, इ, ई using image anchors.
quizOutline: Which letter matches mango?
Which letter matches tamarind?
Which sound is longer: इ or ई?
Which letter should be shown after hearing sugarcane?
What should the learner do before tracing?
lessons.heroPrompt: A colorful early-Hindi lesson poster showing four large Devanagari vowels अ आ इ ई, with mango, tamarind, sugarcane, and a clean anchor card layout, child-safe educational art.

videoScenes.narration: Today we learn four swar: अ, आ, इ, ई.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Four glowing vowel cards in a row on a cream background.

videoScenes.narration: आ for आम. इ for इमली. ई for ईख.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Three simple picture cards: mango, tamarind, sugarcane, each beside the matching letter.

videoScenes.narration: Each sound repeats seven times with pauses.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Animated sound-wave dots under each letter card.

videoScenes.narration: Trace after listening.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Dotted tracing sheets for the four swar.

videoScenes.narration: Show me आ. Show me इ. Show me ई.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Teacher hand pointing to mixed letter cards.

lessons.title: Swar Set 2
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner recognizes उ, ऊ, ए, ऐ and starts simple sound discrimination.
quizOutline: Which letter matches glasses?
Which word is the anchor for ऊ?
Which sound is shorter: उ or ऊ?
Which card should be picked after hearing ए?
What happens after this lesson?
lessons.heroPrompt: A bright Hindi vowel lesson card featuring उ ऊ ए ऐ, with child-safe owl, wool, heel, and glasses anchors, uncluttered school illustration style.

videoScenes.narration: Now we add उ, ऊ, ए, ऐ.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Four new vowel cards appearing one by one.

videoScenes.narration: उ is shorter. ऊ is longer.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Two cards side by side for उ and ऊ with wave shapes showing short and long.

videoScenes.narration: ए and ऐ sound different. Listen carefully.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Letter cards ए and ऐ with simple mouth-shape icons.

videoScenes.narration: उल्लू, ऊन, एड़ी, ऐनक.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Four anchor images arranged in a clean 2x2 grid.

videoScenes.narration: Now mix all eight swar and listen carefully.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Eight vowel cards shuffled across a playful cream background.

lessons.title: First Sound Confidence Check
lessons.learningOutcome: Learner completes a calm mixed-sound check and knows whether to repeat H1 or move to H2.
quizOutline: Play a sound and choose the matching letter.
Play आम and choose the matching swar.
Which two sounds need the learner's extra revision?
Should the learner be pushed forward if still confused?
What is the next pack after H1?
lessons.heroPrompt: A cheerful mixed-swar revision board with eight large Devanagari vowel cards and a calm parent-guided check atmosphere, bright but uncluttered.

videoScenes.narration: This is not an exam. It is a confidence check.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Smiling child and parent seated together with flashcards on a table.

videoScenes.narration: Hear the sound. Point to the right card.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Eight mixed swar flashcards in a semicircle.

videoScenes.narration: Hear the word. Choose the matching swar.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Anchor picture cards for mango, tamarind, wool, glasses and more.

videoScenes.narration: Repeat only the weak sounds. Celebrate the strong ones.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Green check marks on known sounds and gentle highlight on missed sounds.

videoScenes.narration: If the learner is ready, next comes H2 consonants.
videoScenes.visualPrompt: Preview cards with क ख ग घ on a soft golden background.
